title: Open canonical resolution section transfer
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$, $G$, $I$, $J$, $\alpha$, $h_\alpha$, $c_X$, and $c_Y$ be as follows: $G$ is an abelian etale sheaf on $X$, $I$ resolves $G$, $J$ resolves $g^*G$, $\alpha:I\to g_*J$ preserves the augmentation, and $c_X,c_Y$ are normalized comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. For every open $W\subseteq X$, $q$, and $x\in H^q(I(W))$, $c_{Y,g^{-1}W}^q(H^q(T_W)x)=\operatorname{openCohomologyPullback}(g,W,G,q)(c_{X,W}^q(x))$. Here $T$ is the explicit section transfer [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer] and pullback is [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback].

proof.text: Use AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective and the epimorphism homologyπ to represent x by a cycle z. Transfer z by cyclesMap. The sectionsEquiv inverse explicitly constructs the unique representing morphisms fX and fY. Its coefficient naturality and iCycles_d prove both are Hom cocycles (the private proved helper section_cocycle).

Mathlib homologyπ_naturality rewrites the transferred class as the class of the transferred cycle. Apply cX.open_cocycle and cY.open_cocycle to replace the two comparison values by the respective open-object images of extMk. The sections compatibility needed by the Ext transfer theorem follows from cyclesMap_i and apply_symm_apply; apply resolutionSection_transfer_open_ext to finish.

proof_origin.place: Formal reduction: homologyπ surjectivity and naturality, sections adjunction naturality and normalization; Ext transfer isolated in lem-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-open-transfer-ext

from.place: The resolution-section comparison: normalized Hom cocycles, their restriction, and their augmentation-preserving pullback transfer, below the Mayer-Vietoris comparison.

lean.statement: theorem resolutionSection_canonical_transfer_open {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (I : InjectiveResolution G) (J : InjectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)) (α : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) (hα : I.ι.f 0 ≫ α.f 0 = (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).unit.app G ≫ (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (J.ι.f 0)) (cX : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I) (cY : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G) J) : ∀ W q x, cY.openEquiv (g ⁻¹ᵁ W) q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (openResolutionSectionTransfer g I.cocomplex J.cocomplex α W) q x) = openCohomologyPullback g W G q (cX.openEquiv W q x)
